phase: Strategy audit only. priorityAssignmentFinding.finding: Priority in the Tokyo inventory is a capacity band, and capacity-unknown records fell to D by default. This is the root cause of the audit's central result.

evidence.consequence: 717 of the 969 Tokyo Priority-D records carry no capacity at all. Priority D is therefore not a small-venue tail; it is the capacity-unknown bucket, and it contains major dedicated Tokyo theatres that were never assessed.

segmentation.rule: Repository metadata only (officialDisplayName, facilityName, spaceName, category, capacity, officialFacilityUrl, discoveryUrlRaw, researchStatus, eligibility). Low-yield vocabulary (studio / rehearsal / training / live house / live spot / multipurpose / meeting / community / gallery / exhibition / gym / rental-room wording) is evaluated first; then small-theatre, 能楽堂, 能舞台, 演芸場, 講堂 and academic-auditorium vocabulary as MEDIUM; then dedicated theatre, concert hall, auditorium, proper-noun hall names, and 大/中/小/主/メインホール designations as HIGH; a recorded sub-100 capacity with no performance vocabulary is demoted to LOW. No Web verification.

remainingHighPotentialInspection.headline: The HIGH bucket is dominated by dedicated, ticketed Tokyo theatres and named concert halls that no wave has ever opened. rankingFunctionAudit.currentRule: researchStatus (source-located first) -> eligibility (likely-eligible first) -> non-null officialFacilityUrl -> recorded capacity descending -> penalty for studio / training / live-house / multipurpose / meeting / movable / free-seating wording or capacity under 100 or unrecorded, applied after a tier-1/tier-2 name-vocabulary screen.

defectsFound.defect: Null capacity is treated as a penalty rather than as absent evidence.
defectsFound.measuredImpact: 84 of the 90 records that even pass the current tier-1/tier-2 name screen have null capacity and are therefore penalised; 79 of the 90 have null capacity AND no direct URL, placing them below every scored candidate. Across all ten Priority-D preflights, 44 of the 45 candidates ever opened had a recorded capacity. Zero capacity-unknown dedicated theatres have ever been opened.
defectsFound.whyItIsWrong: Capacity is missing because the 東京都 discovery list left the cell blank, not because the venue is small. 717 of 969 Priority-D records are null-capacity, and the priority band itself was assigned from that same missing capacity, so the penalty double-counts one absent field.

defectsFound.defect: The tier-1/tier-2 vocabulary screen misses proper-noun halls.
defectsFound.measuredImpact: The screen matches 90 of the 787 outstanding records. A further 273 outstanding records carry a hall name without matching 劇場/シアター/大・中・小ホール - including 第一生命ホール, 品川インターシティホール, ヤクルトホール, 草月ホール, 明治安田ホール丸の内, 後楽園ホール, ムラマツホール, スパイラルホール, NEW PIER HALL and TOKYO NODE HALL.
defectsFound.whyItIsWrong: A single-purpose hall named after its owner is at least as likely to have a fixed numbered chart as a room labelled 〔小ホール〕.

defectsFound.measuredImpact: In PREFLIGHT 3 this promoted a 75-seat 助産師会館〔講堂〕 above a 130-seat civic 大ホール, and both above every dedicated theatre in the pool. Result: 0 ADOPT.
defectsFound.whyItIsWrong: source-located records how far an earlier wave got, not whether the issuer publishes a complete numbered chart. It is a convenience signal, and convenience is the cheapest part of the work: locating a URL costs one lookup, whereas a venue with no fixed numbered seating can never be adopted at any cost.

defectsFound.defect: Direct-URL presence is read as a yield signal.
defectsFound.measuredImpact: 533 of the 787 outstanding records carry no URL at all, including 90 of the 109 high-potential records.
defectsFound.whyItIsWrong: Absence of a URL in the discovery row says nothing about the issuer's published material.

rankingFunctionAudit.combinedEffect: The four defects compose into a filter that selects for 'small municipal or institutional room whose capacity happened to be printed in the prefectural list' and against 'named performance venue'. That is the exact population the last four waves drilled, and the exact reason their ADOPT rate collapsed. The declining yield measures the ranking rule, not the Tokyo candidate universe.

recommendedYieldOrientedRule.note: Research ordering only. It changes no evidence, adoption, production-gate, or policy contract, and it does not reclassify any inventory priority.
recommendedYieldOrientedRule.step1_fixedNumberedSeatLikelihoodAndPerf: Primary key, ordered: (1a) dedicated ticketed performance identity - 劇場, シアター, theater, theatre, 演芸場, 能楽堂, 音楽堂, コンサートホール, オーディトリアム, AND proper-noun single-purpose hall names; (1b) municipal or public hall with an explicit 大/中/小/主/メインホール designation; (2) 講堂, academic auditorium, 能舞台, 小劇場; (3) 地区センター〔ホール〕, 公民館ホール, 学習館〔講堂〕, レクリエーションホール, 区民ホール and comparable flat-floor civic rooms; (4) excluded from preflight - studio, rehearsal/training, live house, live spot, multipurpose, meeting/conference, free-seating, movable-chair general rental.
recommendedYieldOrientedRule.step2_assignedTicketLikelihood: Within a tier, prefer a producing or commercially programmed operator over a rental-only room.
recommendedYieldOrientedRule.step3_issuerPrecedent: Within a tier, prefer an issuer already in production with a validated chart convention (紀伊國屋 for 0690, 北区 for 0890/0891/0886/0887, 調布市 for 1068, 一橋大学 for 1142, the 能楽堂 lane for 0316), and demote any record whose sibling space at the same issuer already returned DEFER (1127 after 1126; 0444 after 0443).
recommendedYieldOrientedRule.step4_capacity: Recorded capacity descending, with null treated as NEUTRAL at tier level - never as a penalty. Apply the sub-100 penalty only to a RECORDED capacity under 100.
recommendedYieldOrientedRule.step5_urlAndPriorProgress: Direct/current issuer URL, then source-located/likely-eligible, as the final tie-breaks only.
recommendedYieldOrientedRule.whatChanges: Steps 1-3 replace what is currently step 5. The existing penalty vocabulary is kept but is applied only to explicit low-yield wording and to a recorded sub-100 capacity.

yieldHistory.candidateProfileOverTheSameRun: The recorded capacity of the opened candidates fell from a 176-237 band in waves 1-3 to 20-130 in waves 6-7 and 75-159 in wave 10. Every opened candidate but one had a recorded capacity, and none was a dedicated commercial theatre with an unrecorded capacity. The ADOPT-rate decline tracks the ranking rule walking down the capacity-recorded civic-room list, not the exhaustion of Tokyo's performance venues.

pathA_continueOrdinaryTokyoPriorityD.remainingPlausibleHighYieldCount: 109 high-potential records (102 of them never scored because capacity is null), plus about 100 medium-potential records. 273 outstanding records carry a hall name the current screen never even examined.
pathA_continueOrdinaryTokyoPriorityD.likelyAdoptRate: The last four waves ran at 10% initial ADOPT while drilling capacity-recorded civic rooms. Waves 1-3, whose candidates were dedicated performance venues (吉祥寺シアター, 赤坂RED/THEATER, 矢来能楽堂, セルリアンタワー能楽堂, 紀伊國屋ホール), ran at 61.5%. The high-potential bucket is the same population as waves 1-3, so a corrected ranking should recover a materially higher rate; a conservative planning figure is 30-50%.
pathA_continueOrdinaryTokyoPriorityD.expectedAddedVenuesSeats: Dedicated Tokyo theatres and municipal 大/小ホール are typically 200-800 seats, against the 104-208 seats the last three productions added. A five-candidate preflight at 40% would add roughly 2 venues and 600-1,200 seats.

pathA_continueOrdinaryTokyoPriorityD.diminishingReturnRisk: LOW for the high-potential bucket, which is untouched. HIGH and already realised for the capacity-recorded civic-room stream, which must drop to tier 3.

pathC_expandOutsideTokyo.obviousGaps: 93% of production is Tokyo. The P0 tier defined in AGENTS.md (Tokyo/Kanagawa/Chiba/Saitama) has 3 / 1 / 1 venues outside Tokyo. P1 (Ibaraki/Tochigi/Gunma) has 1. P2 (Sapporo/Sendai/Nagoya/Kyoto/Osaka/Kobe/Hiroshima/Fukuoka) has 3 across all eight cities. This is the largest structural gap in the repository.

pathC_expandOutsideTokyo.pendingHighPriorityHalls: 博多座, 御園座, フェスティバルホール, オリックス劇場, 梅田芸術劇場, 神奈川県民ホール 大ホール, ミューザ川崎, よこすか芸術劇場, 埼玉会館, 大宮ソニックシティ, 川口リリア, ウェスタ川越, 高崎芸術劇場, 札幌Kitara, hitaru, 仙台サンプラザ, 東京エレクトロンホール宮城, ロームシアター京都, 愛知県芸術劇場, 神戸文化ホール and others - every one already blocked.
pathC_expandOutsideTokyo.blockerProfile: Roughly half are hard evidence contradictions in 2,000-seat-class halls (埼玉会館 1F off by 22; ウェスタ川越 3F 594 vs 576; 高崎芸術劇場 2F 480 vs 448; ロームシアター京都 2,013 vs 2,005; 愛知県芸術劇場 176 vs 177; アクロス福岡 independent-review-mismatch). The other half are source-location failures where the registered URL 404s, 403s, or redirects (習志野文化ホール, 船橋市民文化ホール, 千葉市文化センター アートホール, 東京エレクトロンホール宮城, イズミティ21, 神戸国際会館, 神戸新聞松方ホール, JMSアステールプラザ 大ホール, 栃木県総合文化センター メインホール).
pathC_expandOutsideTokyo.assessment: Strategically necessary, but not currently a higher-yield lane than a corrected Tokyo ranking. Every existing non-Tokyo candidate is already blocked, most on DENSE or JUDGMENT-class contradictions, and opening a genuinely new region first requires a discovery-source normalization macro on the scale of the 1,208-row Tokyo import. The URL-unreachable subgroup (about 9 records) is the cheapest non-Tokyo work and is the natural follow-on macro once Tokyo's high-potential theatre bucket is drained.

rationale: Tokyo Priority D has NOT exhausted its high-yield stage. It has exhausted one stratum - capacity-recorded small civic and institutional rooms - because the ranking rule could only see that stratum.

109 high-potential and about 100 medium-potential records remain outstanding, and 102 of the 109 have never been scored by any wave because their capacity cell is empty. A repository-wide grep confirms PARCO劇場, 三越劇場, 第一生命ホール, 博品館劇場, 紀伊國屋サザンシアター, 宝生能楽堂, 鈴本演芸場, 日本橋劇場, せんがわ劇場 and 兼松講堂 appear in no report, batch, or doc, and none is production under any other identity.

This is the highest-yield path on criterion 1 (production venue count per unit of research) and the strongest path on criterion 2 (theatre / concert / live-event venues first), because the untouched bucket is almost entirely dedicated performance venues.
Criterion 3 is unaffected: only research ordering changes. Evidence order, the production gate, and every disposition stay as they are.
Criterion 4: the cost is the same five-candidate bounded preflight that has been running, with a corrected sort key.
